description: This Java class, LogWrapper, implements the LogNode interface and acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log utility. It facilitates logging with additional functionality, such as chaining multiple log nodes together for flexible log management.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps around Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface for flexible logging chains.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with specified priority, tag, and throwable; also propagates the log to the next node in the chain if present.
